text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- Visiting Singaporean Deputy Prime Minister and Defence Minister Tony Tan Kengyam held talks with Vietnam's Communist Party Secretary General Do Muoi and Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet on Wednesday to improve understanding and friendship between the two countries.
-- The World Bank has warned in a report that Vietnam's flourishing international commerce has spurred a widening of the trade and current account deficits.
-- Vietnam has issued measures to stop the increasing number of people illegaly migrating to Hongkong.
-- The PetroVietnam Trading company (Petechim) had exported 43 million tonnes of crude oil by mid-November.
-- The Dutch Government has granted Vietnam non-refundable aid of $1.95 million to finance auditing at four Vietnamese commercial banks.
-- Vietnam says all individuals, private and state enterprises, state offices and other organizations charged with dodging tax may have to bear the criminal responsibility.
